search_space: Every alpha in the fixed ordered finite list [0, 1, -1, 2, -2] was checked exactly by comparing the rational coefficient of sqrt(2) in -alpha/sqrt(2) with the coefficient in -sqrt(2)*alpha.
witness_description: alpha = 1. The substitution x=(t-alpha)/sqrt(2) gives the error-function argument -1/sqrt(2), whereas the displayed identity uses -sqrt(2).
refutation_explanation: Exactly, -1/sqrt(2)=-(1/2)sqrt(2), which differs from -sqrt(2). Since erf is strictly increasing (its defining integrand is positive), the two right-hand sides differ, so alpha = 1 violates the displayed identity.
